info.description: The header: wordmark, menu links, and the sticky order button.

logo_text.description: The wordmark in the top-left corner, used if no logo image is uploaded below. Set as text so it stays sharp at every screen size.

logo_image.description: SVG wordmark, if you have one. Optional - the text above is the fallback and is used until this is set.

logo_image_alt.description: Describes the logo image for screen readers. Fill this in whenever a logo image is uploaded.

nota_mark.description: The standalone NOTA mark shown top-right on mobile. Optional - the mobile header lays out fine without it, just without that mark.

nota_mark_alt.description: Describes the mark for screen readers. Fill this in whenever the mark is uploaded.

mobile_menu_image.description: Photo shown behind the mobile menu overlay when it opens.

mobile_menu_image_alt.description: Describes the mobile menu photo for screen readers.

items.description: Menu links, in display order. Between 1 and 8 - more than 8 will not fit the header.

order_button_label.description: Text on the header's order button.

order_product_name.description: Product name on the header's order button.

order_price.description: Price on the header's order button. Change it here and in the Hero section - they appear in two places.
